note: Public whitelist snapshot. Internal FSR, IF, TR, evidence, comments, issues and review data are excluded.

work_packages.name: Basic Motion
work_packages.description: 速度、轉向、煞車 command/feedback；速度閉迴路；基本路徑追蹤；正常減速/停車與 actuator plausibility。

work_packages.name: Dynamic Safety Limits
work_packages.description: 速度/轉向角/轉向速率/加減速度限制；overspeed detection；a_y / stability envelope；接受降級命令。

work_packages.name: Brake / Safe Stop
work_packages.description: Brake self-test；Normal Stop / MRC / Cat.1 / Cat.0；Local/Remote E-stop；drive fault→brake；parking anti-roll。

work_packages.name: Navigation / A→B
work_packages.description: 場域 map、lane、zone、geofence；A→B route；waypoint/path/trajectory；route validity 與 restricted zone。

work_packages.name: Localization Fallback / Integrity
work_packages.description: Localization integrity / time-to-alert；GNSS loss、RTK degradation、pose jump；fallback / safe-stop request。

work_packages.name: Sensor HW：選型 / 採購 / 支架 / 安裝
work_packages.description: FoV/range/update rate/blind-zone 規格；Sensor 選型採購；支架、防震/防水；車端電源與網路整合。

work_packages.name: Sensor Calibration / Coverage Evidence
work_packages.description: Intrinsic/extrinsic calibration；時間同步；整車 sensor coverage map；遮蔽、震動、雨霧/夜間基本確認。

work_packages.name: Static Perception Safety
work_packages.description: 人/車/AGV/障礙物 detection；warning/protective field；static risk → slowdown/stop request。

work_packages.name: Dynamic Tracking / Risk Estimation
work_packages.description: Object tracking、distance / relative velocity；dynamic collision-risk；依風險輸出 warning/slowdown/stop。

work_packages.name: Confidence / Degradation / Health
work_packages.description: Sensor confidence、health、degradation；single-sensor loss；degraded perception 或 MRC request。

work_packages.name: Mission / State
work_packages.description: Mission receive/validate/accept/reject/cancel；operational state machine；fault classification/latch/reset；禁止重大故障 auto restart。

work_packages.name: Vehicle Integration
work_packages.description: 定位、導航、感知、控制、STM、Safety chain 整車整合。

work_packages.name: FSR Trace Closure / Release Evidence
work_packages.description: FSR→Test Case→Result→Evidence；關閉年度 scope FSR/TBD/coverage gap；release evidence package。

checkpoints.name: Baseline / Allocation
checkpoints.capability: 完成系統架構、IF 責任邊界、年度 FSR allocation；啟動 Sensor 規格與採購。

checkpoints.name: Basic Motion
checkpoints.capability:
• 定位可輸出 pose、heading、velocity 基本資訊
• 可執行直行、定速、轉向與基本路徑追蹤
• 速度、轉向、煞車 command / feedback 已形成基本閉迴路
• 具備正常停車、停止保持與 E-stop basic chain
checkpoints.review_checks:
• 量測 localization error / heading error 與基本定位穩定性
• 驗證 speed / steering tracking 與 command-feedback 一致性
• 驗證 brake feedback、基本 stopping distance 與停止保持
• 觸發 Local / Remote E-stop，確認 request 可進入車端停止鏈

checkpoints.name: A→B Autonomy
checkpoints.capability:
• 可在核准 map / geofence 內執行指定 A→B 自主循跡
• Navigation 可產生 waypoint / path / trajectory 供 CTL 追蹤
• 可判斷 route validity，禁止進入 restricted zone
• Mission 可 receive / validate / accept / reject / cancel
• 具備 MANUAL / REMOTE / AUTO 基本 mode / authority 管理；暫不考慮障礙物
checkpoints.review_checks:
• 執行 A→B navigation 與重複循跡測試
• 驗證 route 位於 ODD / geofence，並測試 route invalid / restricted zone
• 檢查 mission accept/reject/cancel 與 vehicle state 回報
• 驗證 authority request / grant / release 與非法控制來源拒絕
• 定位退化或 route invalid 時確認可提出 fallback / safe-stop request

checkpoints.name: Static Perception Safety
checkpoints.capability:
• 完成 Camera 等 Sensor 安裝、校正與整車 coverage 建立
• 可偵測 pedestrian / vehicle / AGV / 靜態 obstacle
• 建立 warning field 與 protective field
• 偵測人員或靜態障礙物進入風險區時，可輸出 slowdown / stop request
• Safety chain 可將 stop trigger 串接至車輛降速/停車
checkpoints.review_checks:
• 審查安裝圖、Calibration report、coverage / blind-zone evidence
• 以不同位置/距離測試 pedestrian / vehicle / obstacle detection
• 驗證 warning / protective field 邊界與 trigger
• 執行 trigger → decision → brake → stopped 的基本 E2E 測試
• 記錄 detection miss、blind-zone 與 Sensor 異常案例

checkpoints.name: Dynamic / Degraded Perception
checkpoints.capability:
• 可進行動態障礙物 object tracking、distance / relative velocity estimation
• 依 collision risk 輸出 warning / slowdown / stop request
• 建立 Sensor confidence、health、integrity / degradation 判斷
• 感知能力不足時可進入 degraded perception 或要求 MRC
• 控制端可依 overspeed、a_y / stability envelope 執行限速、降速或停止
checkpoints.review_checks:
• 執行動態 pedestrian / vehicle / AGV tracking scenario
• 驗證不同距離/相對速度下 slowdown / stop trigger
• 進行 Sensor loss / degradation fault injection
• 驗證 confidence / integrity 下降後的 degraded response
• 測試 overspeed、a_y / stability boundary 與 safety limit trigger

checkpoints.name: Vehicle Safety Verification
checkpoints.capability: 年度 scope 的整車 A→B + 障礙安全處置；E-stop、comm loss、watchdog、主要 subsystem fault；Cat.1/Cat.0。

checkpoints.name: Prototype Release
checkpoints.capability: 形成年度 Autonomous Prototype release baseline；凍結 software/parameter/sensor/calibration/document versions；FSR closure review。
